name: Nicole Fields Photography
tagline: Relaxed, natural photography for Chicagoland families.
description: I'm Nikki — the photographer behind Nicole Fields Photography, based in West Chicago and serving families all around Chicagoland. My style is laid-back and unhurried: I take each session moment by moment and go with the flow, so it never feels rushed or stiff. The goal is simple — a session that's genuinely fun and relaxed, and photographs that look like the real, warm, everyday you.
about_long: Photography is my form of personal expression, and my family is my whole heart — my husband and our two boys keep life joyful and a little chaotic in the best way. That's exactly the kind of real, in-between moment I love to capture for other families. I shoot on professional-grade Nikon equipment and I'm fully insured and registered with the State of Illinois, so you can relax and just be present while I do the rest.
